pages.title: Gene Sampler
pages.text: A slim needle on a neutronium handle, tipped with a quantum dot that reads base pairs as it draws them. One quick touch takes a genome sample. Touch a creature from another dimension and the dot reads something that is not DNA at all.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed a way to copy a creature's blueprint without harming it. A quantum dot on a stick, backed by neutronium so it would not flex, was enough to read a genome on contact. The first creature I sampled barely noticed.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Casimir Effect.
